description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weligaga, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320042 (24/0706)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
